title: Which places get Parliament's attention?
excerpt: A century of Hansard and 1,596 UK towns. London took 49% of the Commons' town mentions in the 1910s and 18% in the 2010s, yet where a place stands is still mostly about the place itself.
seo_description: A century of House of Commons mentions of 1,596 UK towns: how attention spread out from London, and what decides a place's share.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Which places get Parliament's attention?' beside a map of UK towns coloured red where their share of Commons mentions grew and blue where it shrank.
